preservation: Preserve updates to built workspace dependencies consumed by running applications. Record changed runtime source and dist hashes, actual loaded artifact identity, expected owning service restart and readiness recovery. A validation build alone is not runtime delivery proof. Use ordinary Make preparation/watch behavior; no manual dist transfer or controller repair in this definition.

With no intended runtime source/dependency input change, forced validation must cause zero application restart/recreation and zero runtime artifact churn. Record before/after source, dependency, image and process identities. Validation-only output must not masquerade as a runtime dependency update. The public HMR and presence probes below are the only additional mutations in this fixed window.

httpSequence: Authenticate through protected preview with Clerk; keep tokens private. Create fresh Wallpaper per history, resolve its Asset ID. Historical fixed idempotency keys require isolated/reset data.

For each history index i, POST /asset/assets/{assetId}/source-candidates with operation add, expectedSourceSetRevision 0 and history-i key; require 201, then DELETE returned candidate and require 200/cancelled.
GET oldest exact candidate requires 200, identical candidate ID and cancelled status. Equal history-0 replay requires 201 and same candidate ID/status; revision 1 reuse requires 409.

GET sources requires 200 and newest 32 cancelled outcomes in reverse ordinal order. Use returned nextCandidateCursor for history 2048 to fetch next 32 with no overlap and correct ordering. History 32 has no next cursor; historical synthetic 0:oldest cursor returned an empty second page.
GET missing candidate requires 404; unsigned sources requires 401.

Two simultaneous identical concurrency-control creates at revision 0 require 201/201 and same candidate ID; cancel once requires 200/cancelled. New stale-revision-control at 999999 requires 409 and no persisted mutation.
databaseEvidence: Before concurrency controls, retained counts exactly 32/2048, next ordinal 32/2048, embedded candidates 0, active sources 0; bounded membership bytes at both sizes. Historical live membership was 385 bytes; integration fixture was 320, not a universal byte requirement.

Capture actual pg statements and returned-row counts at production adapter boundary using committed source-query-work fixture; EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECTs under same conditions after ANALYZE. Do not infer bounded work from latency alone.

Committed sourceQueryWork requires fewer than 32 observed queries per operation, candidate results <=33, candidate SELECT examined rows <=64, candidate writes affected rows <=1. It sums candidate relation rows plus rows removed by filter times loops.

Historical standalone probe EXPLAINs status primary key, replay key, first page and ordinal cursor page, and pending count. Retain plans/index names and actual rows/buffers, not only the index definitions.

Transaction rollback control locks owned Asset, temporarily writes revision 999999, ROLLBACK restores revision 0. This proves DB rollback, not application exception rollback; use owning integration test for that guarantee.
unsafeOrMissingAssertions: Historical PostgreSQL probe hard-codes two old Asset IDs; never execute unchanged on another database. Rebind to newly created receipt IDs in reviewed temporary source and hash that adaptation separately.

Historical probe was manually copied into container; this is failure/intervention evidence, never a clean delivery path. Its EXPLAIN queries are manually reconstructed, not traced HTTP statements, and it logs plans without asserting index choice/work limits.

HTTP historical controls omit explicit status-body cancelled checks, page1 HTTP status, page identity/order/non-overlap, active membership assertions and no-mutation checks after conflict/stale revision. Require these independently; historical JSON alone does not pass them.

Global Client.prototype.query interception must stay serial and restore descriptor; re-EXPLAIN occurs after transaction, so retain that measurement limit. Candidate row estimator does not measure every PostgreSQL buffer or hidden operation.
Historical HTTP seeding is asynchronous and lacks an overall deadline. Observe completion/errors with bounded existing application/test deadlines; do not increase timeouts or retry opaque failures.
Historical fixed assets, dates, idempotency keys and sessionStorage are provenance, not reusable live state. No stored token/session can be committed.

Canonical container migration/backfill and safe generated-output return are still unqualified. Existing integration backfill fixture starts after SQL migration; it does not prove canonical deployment context.

publicHmr.editMethod: Require the pinned regular local file, exact blob/SHA-256 and one anchor occurrence before editing. Replace only anchor with replacement in the owned local source; record write time and edited SHA-256. Ordinary development synchronization must deliver it. Do not modify worker/container source directly.
publicHmr.restoreMethod: After observing editedText, require the current local file still equals the recorded edited bytes. Restore the exact pinned original bytes locally and record write time. On conflict stop without overwriting newer work. Require original blob/SHA-256 and baselineText after restoration.
publicHmr.documentProof: Before T0 record URL, performance.timeOrigin and a random document-only nonce on window. Poll selector text, timeOrigin and nonce every 1000ms through T0+120s. Require exact visible text and unchanged timeOrigin/nonce for edit, restore and final receipt. Do not reload, navigate, replace the page or reinitialize the nonce. DOM writes cannot stand in for source HMR. A changed document fails this round.
publicHmr.archiveLimit: Archived hmr-observer.js observes body text only. It supplies neither source mutation nor restoration/deletion proof and cannot satisfy this procedure by itself.

presence.request: From the same public browser document, fetch this path with cache: no-store and Accept: application/javascript. Record status and marker-present boolean only, not unrelated response bodies. One request deadline is 5000ms; poll every 1000ms until the phase deadline.
presence.createMethod: Before T0 require the local path absent, container path absent and public request 404 with marker absent. Create exactly bytes locally with exclusive-create semantics, never overwrite. Ordinary source synchronization/Compose watch delivers it. Require local and container SHA-256 equal bytes hash, HTTP 200 and BOAT-548-PRESENCE in response.
presence.deleteMethod: Only unlink the owned local regular file after its bytes hash still matches. Record deletion time. Require local lstat ENOENT, container test ! -e succeeds and the same public request returns 404 with marker absent. A Vite HTML fallback with status 200 fails absence proof. No manual remote deletion or cache-busting substitute.

sampling.commandTemplate: make boat-sample ARGS='<absolute inventory.json> <absolute fresh output directory>'
sampling.selection: Exactly the singleton issue 548. Bind the placeholder to the coordinator-admitted absolute worktree before T0 and freeze inventory SHA-256 in receipts. No other active root/worker stack belongs in this sample; no empty, duplicate or implicit selection.
sampling.interface: Run the pinned sampler from the frozen infrastructure checkout. Two positional arguments only, with optional --once for preflight. Continuous observation must omit --once. No invented --duration, --interval, --routes or --issues flags. Sampler reads each selected .boat/state.json and .worktree, performs read-only worker SSH internally and never resumes a worker. No direct operator SSH or provider operations.
sampling.address: Sampler uses http://127.0.0.1:<selected .worktree INGRESS_PORT>. Public browser uses the owned make boat-preview URL with the same paths. Do not freeze a historical port or remote hostname.
sampling.actualCadence: Sampler starts a new batch after max(0, 10000 - batch duration). Routes and selected stacks run concurrently; slow batches reduce cadence. Retain actual started/ended timestamps. Reject batch duration or adjacent start gap greater than 25000ms; do not claim ideal fixed cadence from configuration alone.
sampling.window: T0 is the first continuous batch started after readiness and immediately before forced-check dispatch. Require at least 120000ms from T0 through a complete batch started at or after T0+120000ms, at least 7 complete batches, and no missing route or stack. After that final batch, create output/sampling-stop and await sampler exit within 25000ms. Existing stop file or reused output invalidates the run.
sampling.assertions: Every batch must contain exactly issue 548, the same owned worker id, all eight routes exactly once, no error/stopped result and allHealthy=true. Require HTTP 200 for every route, stronger than sampler healthy which accepts 200-399. Worker resource errors are failures even if healthy=true. Keep aligned-samples.jsonl and its SHA-256; sample failures remain failures without selective retry.

schedule: Before T0: verify source contracts and HMR source; record application/infrastructure/descriptor SHA, inventory hash, complete input manifest, runtime-built dependency hashes, worker/Compose/watcher/process identities. Start with make dev and make boat-preview only after admission. Require all eight routes HTTP 200 within 120000ms of startup, using pinned sampler --once preflight and unchanged public document baseline. Require presence path absent in local source, runtime container and HTTP.

At T0: dispatch make check PACKAGE=asset FORCE=1 once in the owned development checkout with watcher active; record dispatch, actual process start, exit time/status and log SHA. Record its actual active interval separately from the observation window. Do not sleep, repeat checks, inject source changes or pad the command to claim 120 seconds of command activity. Require at least one complete health batch during that active interval or report insufficient overlap.
At T0+10000ms: perform the exact public HMR text edit. Require visible editedText in the original document within 20000ms of the write.
At T0+40000ms: restore exact original HMR source bytes. Require visible baselineText and editedText absent in the original document within 20000ms of restoration.
At T0+70000ms: exclusively create presence.localPath. Require local/runtime hashes and HTTP 200 with marker within 20000ms of creation.
At T0+100000ms: delete the owned presence file. Require local/runtime absence and HTTP 404 with no marker within 20000ms of deletion.

Through T0+120000ms and the final complete sample: keep the original browser document, watcher and sampler active even if the check exits earlier. Then await the check if still active under the existing command deadline; retain its full interval and failure. No missing phase may borrow evidence from another round.

After the window: require original HMR source hash locally and inside web container, absence of the presence file locally/runtime/HTTP, unchanged document identity, and the same process/readiness receipts. Full make ci is a separate once-per-admitted-issue validation at frozen inputs with watcher active, after these temporary mutations are gone. No generated final SQL is preloaded. Failure leaves qualification pending.

processReceipts.beforeAfter: Freeze owned worktree, worker id/runningSince, Compose project, watcher id/start identity and local daemon/process start identities. For each app record container ID, image ID, State.Pid, State.StartedAt and RestartCount before/after. Never dump Config.Env or complete private state/enrollment files. Include every owned container child process PID, PPID, start time and executable name, since a tsx/node child can restart while container PID/RestartCount stay unchanged. Exclude command arguments and environment.

processReceipts.events: Retain owned Compose watch sync/restart/rebuild events and app lifecycle timestamps during the entire window, not only endpoint snapshots. Missing process/event evidence cannot prove zero restarts. The window permits no planned restart; public src edit/create/delete use sync. A dependency update in a separate admitted step must show its own expected restart, old/new loaded artifact hashes, and HTTP 200 recovery on all affected routes within 120000ms. Do not count a validation-only build as that update.
processReceipts.failure: Unexpected restart/recreate, changed process start identity, missed health deadline, changed source contracts, unintended runtime-built artifact churn, or incomplete source restoration fails the round. Retain evidence and perform owned cleanup without claiming qualification. Coordinator owns stop/resume/provider receipts.
processReceipts.commandUse: Expand templates only with the frozen owned project/container IDs. Capture inspect/top before T0, at each mutation/restoration/deletion boundary and after the final sample. Use header-only sha256sum before/after, the two-file sha256sum only while presence exists, and test ! -e before creation and after deletion. Retain exit statuses. These ordinary routed read-only commands and sampler traffic do not extend the forced-check active interval.
